integrity: Complete analytic proof with independent finite-dimensional numerical reproducibility script; a single self-review, not an independent audit or guaranteed historical novelty.
limitations: The theorem is for fixed real 1<p<2, integer d>=2 and invariant Euclidean affine-line sampling, with leading asymptotics and conditional weak limits only. Historical priority remains uncertain because the full Ren (2014) and Wilkinson--Li--Patchigolla (2006) treatments were inaccessible. Numerical tests do not replace the proof.
title: Singular-curvature extreme-chord tails and Dirichlet endpoint limits for Euclidean \(\ell_p\) balls
